        mdnEncodingReplacements.put("%3F", "\\?");

        mdnEncodingReplacements.put("%3A", ":");

        mdnEncodingReplacements.put("%40", "@");

        mdnEncodingReplacements.put("%26", "&");

        mdnEncodingReplacements.put("%3D", "=");

        mdnEncodingReplacements.put("%2B", "\\+");
